limitations: Only one positive bounded observable, not generator-invariant dictionaries.
Unstabilized scalar Galerkin estimates with a finite nonnegative ridge; frozen trained step and iid invariant samples.
Strong population contraction and exact explicit exponent are demonstrated only for circle Brownian diffusion; claims do not extend to resampled-in-time or structurally projected generators.
Does not challenge finite-horizon or large-sample-first convergence.
scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of a fixed-finite-data, all-horizon rare-event mechanism; deterministic arithmetic tests are supplementary, not independent proof. No fictional empirical measurements.
title: Universal finite-sample anti-dissipativity in scalar stochastic dynamic mode decomposition
